_comment: MuseScore archive songs of the songs lane (pdmx-songs.json): solo piano scores outside classical, folk and religious music (pop, rock, soundtrack, jazz, and unlabelled scores by composers outside the classical list) that the uploader declared public domain or CC0 with no licence conflict. The user's broad copyright reading (2026-10-16): no check of the author's date, so a modern arrangement that the declaration does not cover is a risk the repository carries. Chosen by content/tools/pdmx_songs.py; two removal-only lenses (junk, content safety) took out the flagged ones. Not reviewed by eye. Each was placed at level 6 (Advanced) by the rule in content/tools/pdmx_advanced.py, which the frozen heuristic cannot do (it has no level 6). The rule's thresholds were fixed before the yield was known. A piece passed every gate, or it passed every gate but the span check and the lint law gate, which are relaxed for level 6 within a ceiling: its flags are recorded in `relaxedGates` and in its notes. Pieces are not capped. A song keeps its Songs or Modern collection, so it shows on that shelf at the Challenging level.
